broker-terminal-ux-stage1: UX redesign stage 1 (spec 1.1 and 1.2, Forge). Desktop terminal: broker-terminal, terminal-watchlist, watchlist-toggle, terminal-chart, dock-split, terminal-dock, terminal-ticket, watchlist (Markets list, bare on the terminal). Phone and narrow windows (under 900 px): broker-narrow, trade-bar-slot, trade-bar, bar-side-buy, bar-side-sell, bar-qty (replaces order-qty on the phone), bar-review, trade-sheet, trade-sheet-scrim, trade-sheet-close (the sheet holds order-pad, order-qty, order-submit). Dock: broker-dock, dock-tab-<positions|orders|history|asset|options|markets>, dock-panel-<tab>, orders-empty, history-empty, fill-history, fill-<fillId>. Chart: chart-toolbar (phone: one scrolling toolbar with interval, range, style, percent and indicators), interval-group, interval-<1m|5m|15m|1h|4h|1D>, candle-real, range-<1D|1W|1M|1Y|ALL>, pct-axis, indicators-menu, ind-<sma20|sma50|ema12|bb|vwap|rsi>, chart-readout, chart-readout-change, chart-legend, legend-<id>, legend-remove-<id>. Kept: chart-card, price-chart, chart-ticker, chart-price, positions, open-orders, asset-panel, rivals-board, order-pad, order-qty, order-submit (in the ticket or the sheet).
broker-terminal-ux-stage1-orders: UX redesign stage 1 (spec 1.3 and 1.4, Forge). Chart lines (ChartLevels in LevelLayer.tsx, one pill per line): chart-levels (the overlay), level-<id> on each pill where id is avg, tp-<orderId>, sl-<orderId>, order-<orderId> or alert-<alertId>; level-line-<id> for the dashed rule; level-add-tp and level-add-sl (the +TP and +SL buttons on the average pill); level-cancel-<id> (the inline x). Chart menu (right-click or Alt+click on the chart): chart-menu, menu-buyLimit, menu-sellStop, menu-alert. Ticket: side-buy (Long) and side-sell (Short), order-type (dropdown; type-<market|limit|stop|stop_limit|trailing> on its options), order-type-help (the one-line explainer), unit-shares and unit-usd (the size unit), order-usd-shares (the shares a dollar size buys), order-too-small, order-qty, the chips chip-10 chip-25 chip-50 chip-Max, order-limit, order-stop, order-trail, order-tp and order-sl (always there, also in simple mode), order-tp-move and order-sl-move (the move each leg makes), order-warn (a limit on the marketable side), order-invalid (the refusal under the quantity field; the other refusals sit under their own field as order-limit-refusal, order-stop-refusal, order-trail-refusal, order-tp-refusal, order-sl-refusal), order-summary, order-spread, order-total, order-roundtrip, order-breakeven, order-cash-after, order-bp-after, order-submit (the CTA, whose label is the reason when it is disabled), order-confirm, order-fund-refusal. The bracket toggle (bracket-toggle) and the type buttons (type-*) as buttons are gone: take profit and stop loss are always fields, and the type is the dropdown.
broker-terminal-ux-stage2: UX redesign stage 2 (Forge, partial). Toasts: os-toasts (bottom-right above the shelf; bottom-left when a Broker sits under it), os-toast-<n>, os-toast-more (the overflow count, opens the bell panel). Window title bar: double-click on win-<id>-title maximizes or restores (the Fill toggle). Broker: broker-welcome (the first-run welcome strip, shown until the first trade), watch-name-<id> (the watchlist name, two lines, clamped). The narrow trade sheet shows the order-type picker (order-type) and the dense ticket footer (order-submit pinned).
